snippet.title: Ellingby House (official trailer)
snippet.description:
Official Cinematic trailer for 'Ellingby House'
Coming Soon on Steam 2025.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3247290/Ellingby_House/

Jepfore Games Ltd. are proud to present Ellingby House: a first person point-and-click puzzle adventure. You'll explore the building by navigating between high resolution pre-rendered 360° panoramas, picking up and inspecting items, and interacting with mechanisms and computers.

Music by Murray Munro.

Copyright © 2024 Jepfore Games Ltd. All rights reserved. "Ellingby House" and "Jepfore Games" are registered trademarks of Jepfore Games Ltd.
